# Vice Meridian: Heatwave

[![make.fun · gta6-01](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=gta6-01)
[![rank](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01/kysoog/vice-meridian-heatwave/rank.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01/leaderboard?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=gta6-01)
[![reward](https://make.fun/badge/gta6-01/kysoog/vice-meridian-heatwave/reward.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=gta6-01)

Open-world neon crime sandbox for [make.fun's gta6-01 bounty](https://make.fun/bounty/gta6-01): a complete browser game with driving, walkable streets, story missions, pedestrians, traffic, police pursuit, combat, generated audio, and local saves.

Run `node serve.ts` with Node 22, then visit **http://localhost:8080**. No dependencies need installing.

Build the submission locally with `mkdir -p out && MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts`. See the repository root README and AGENTS.md for controls, architecture, capture, and verification details.
